study_type: Exploratory purposive sample, exact GitHub repository name/description queries; not a market census or independently validated studio ownership list
git_search_protocol: For each first-party creative-service domain, issue one chosen brand/string `in:name,description` query through authenticated first-party GitHub connector; inspect up to 20 candidate repositories. Candidate lexical match is not a verified corporate repo.
claim_boundaries: Search responses are not company GitHub inventories, assistant recommendations, SDK installations or leads
Zero lexical results do not mean absence of GitHub accounts, aliases, organization code or private repositories
Positive lexical results can be unrelated owners and are never automatically assigned to the studio
Source cases and production credits are self-published assertions, not independent certification
The 25 commercial provider websites were selected intentionally; not a random or population-representative sample
